other_failure_modes.description: The model attempts to predict a highly skewed target variable (like price) directly using a linear model without applying a log transformation (e.g., log1p). This typically results in poor performance as linear models are disproportionately penalized by large outlier values when optimizing for RMSE.

summary: The agent successfully pre-processes the data, extracts robust text features (including a domain-informed split of the category paths), and correctly avoids data leakage by fitting vectorizers solely on the training data. However, the agent fails to implement any internal validation strategy to assess the model's performance before generating final test predictions. Furthermore, the agent misses an important preprocessing step for prices (logarithmic target transformation) which is crucial when using linear regression on highly skewed targets.
